# APOWUS Nebulizer

> Official website of APOWUS — manufacturer of portable mesh nebulizers for adults and children.

APOWUS builds quiet, pocket-sized ultrasonic mesh nebulizers for asthma, COPD, bronchitis, and general respiratory care at home or while traveling.

## Key facts

- Brand: APOWUS
- Website: https://myapowus.com/
- Phone: +1-800-284-4873 (Mon–Fri, 9AM–5PM EST)
- Products sold on: Amazon.com (US)
- Amazon brand store: https://www.amazon.com/stores/APOWUS/page/678859B2-A702-4A67-ADDA-027D748AD63E

## Products

1. **Travel & household portable nebulizer** — compact mesh nebulizer for adults and kids.
2. **3-mode portable nebulizer** — 2800 micropores, ≤5 μm particle size.
3. **3 masks + adjustable rate** — handheld kit with masks, mouthpiece, USB-C.

## Specifications

- Mesh membrane: 2800 micropores
- Particle size: ~5 μm
- Noise level: below 25 dB
- Suitable ages: 3 to 75
- Power: rechargeable battery / USB
